main_text.p: Duplex itaq; blasphemia est, immediata una, mediata altera.

Immediata blasphemia est, quâ ipsa Dei majestas sacrosanctissima cōvitiis laceratur, & contumeliosum, vel falsum aliquid de Deo dicitur, quo aut negatur de eo, quod tribuendum illi erat; aut è diverso ei tribuitur, quod minimè ipsi convenit, quâ re ex professo ipsius gloria imminuitur, illique[?] detrahitur. Blasphemia in DeumDe qua blasphemiæ speciè legem hanc Levitici propriè intelligendam esse, casus ille, filii mulieris Israëlitidis, qui legi huic causam dedit, evidenter evincit. Hujusmodi blasphemiarum exempla alia multa in sacris literis, & historiis ecclesiasticis sunt obvia, ut in Pharaone, Exod.5.v.2; in servis regis Syriæ, De blasphemia.1.Reg.20.v.23; in duce regis Samariæ, cujus humeris hic innitebatur, 2.Reg.7.v.2; in Rabsace, Sennaheribi, regis Assyriorum, duce bellico, 2.Reg.18.v.35; in rege Tyri, Ezech.28.v.2; in Nebucadnezare Babylonico, Dan.3.v.14.15; in Holoferne, Judith 6.v.2; in Nicanore, Demetrii regis duce, 2.Macch.15.v.3.5; in Pharisæis, Matth.9.v.34. Matth.12.v.24. Johan.9.verf.23; in populi Judaici turbâ, Joh.7.v.20. Joh.10.verf.20; in summis sacerdotibus, principibus populi, scribis, & Pharisæis, Matth.27.v.39.40; in latrone, Luc.23.v.39; in Juliano apostatâ, Nicephorus lib.10.hist. eccles.cap.7. & Sozomenus lib.6.cap.2. Quæ exempla, brevitatis studio, exscribere huc non volui.
Hanc verò blasphemiam extremo supplicio Blasphemia in Deum capitalis.afficiendam esse, nemo, opinor, sanus dubitave-

The ornament "X" below the last line is a decorative mark, not a catchword, and is left out. The word "illique" shows a doubtful mark over the vowel, so it is marked [?]. The left edge strip is the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. The printed "eft" and "vers." forms are normalised as described in the rules; "verf." is kept as printed.
